questions.question:
Consider the following statement to be true even if it seems to be at variance from commonly known facts and decide which of the conclusions logically follows from the statement.

**Statement:**

The principal of the school punished all the students of class X.

**Conclusions:**

I. The students are guilty of coming late to school.

II. The principal hates the students.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows

questions.solution:
**Conclusions:**

I. The students are guilty of coming late to school → the statement doesn’t mention the reason for the punishment of students. So, conclusion I does not follow.

II. The principal hates the students. → Nothing in the statement indicates the Principal’s dislike for students. Also, one person punishing another cannot lead to the conclusion that there is hatred involved.

So, conclusion II does not follow.

Hence, neither conclusion I nor II follows.
